The excerpt is truncated and the changed head ranges are not visible in the supplied units, so I could not cite or check head lines.

Base context reviewed: deadline and admission policy, MTP, sampling, vision caps, and MiMo and Qwen4 native owners. It touches TB-007 (inference engine) and T-010/T-029 (availability), and T-041 only indirectly, in prefix-cache mentions. - The estimator changes (per-step decode pricing, removal of the 0.5 rate multiplier, out-of-order freshness anchoring) are code-behavior changes in provider-swift/.../Deadline/AdmissionRateEstimators.swift and EnginePerformanceMeasurements. They could affect availability, for example by admitting more work under optimistic estimates. Those source files are not supplied in these units, so the code could not be checked.
- The freshness change (newest observation anchors expiry) bears on the qualified-deadline evidence-freshness claims. Only the documentation was visible.
No threat-model update appears necessary from the visible content.
